governingStatute: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
title: TCS Collection by Electronic Commerce Operators (ECO)
plainTextSummary: Mandates electronic commerce operators to collect tax at source at 1% (0.5% CGST + 0.5% SGST or 1% IGST) on the net value of taxable supplies made through their platform where the consideration is collected by the operator.

keyStatutoryThresholds.label: Statutory Rate (Inter-State)
keyStatutoryThresholds.statutoryBasis: Section 52(1) read with IGST Act Section 20 (1.0% IGST)

officialCitations.authority: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)
officialCitations.subject: Tax Collection at Source (TCS) by Electronic Commerce Operators under Section 52
